answer: Fingerprint the model that produced each answer and re-queue any claim where two submissions share a fingerprint family. Draw auditors from a rotating pool, so no operator builds a jury over time. A farm running 1,000 identities on one model leaks one thread back to its operator, and each re-queued claim costs a second panel and a second wait. The river of cheap clones narrows to a trickle, and the ledge above it is the stake.
